Four Seasons Yachts has named Christian Le Squer Culinary Ambassador of Sedna, the signature fine-dining restaurant aboard Four Seasons I. The announcement was made on 12 November 2026.

## From Le Cinq to the open sea

Le Squer has been executive chef of Le Cinq, the three-Michelin-star restaurant of Four Seasons Hotel George V in Paris, since 2014. Before that he led the kitchen of Pavillon Ledoyen, which kept three Michelin stars for twelve consecutive years.

On board, he will shape Sedna's culinary direction. Throughout 2027 the restaurant will serve his signature tasting menu and an à la carte selection of French gastronomic specialities. He will also guide the yacht's Chef-in-Residence programme and advise on future collaborations, while Sedna's chefs train alongside his team at Le Cinq.

## Two sailings with the chef

Guests can dine with Le Squer on two Chef-in-Residence voyages: the Lesser Antilles, featuring Guadeloupe and Anguilla, from 21 to 28 February 2027, and the Greek Isles, featuring Mykonos and Göcek, from 12 to 19 September 2027.

Sedna sits on Deck 6, with 66 seats inside, 40 outside and a private dining room for up to ten guests. Four Seasons I entered service in March 2026 with 95 suites; Four Seasons II is scheduled for 2028.

Ben Trodd, chief executive of Marc-Henry Cruise Holdings, joint owner and operator of Four Seasons Yachts, says the chef's "influence will be felt at Sedna throughout the year."

## The signal

A palace kitchen is now a brand that can travel. For a yacht, a three-star name gives the dining room an identity from day one; for the chef, the ship is a new stage that reaches guests far from Paris.

Congratulations to Christian Le Squer on this new role.
summary: The chef of Le Cinq at Four Seasons Hotel George V becomes Culinary Ambassador of Sedna, the fine-dining restaurant of the Four Seasons I yacht, with two sailings in his company in 2027.
